purpose: Compact cross-provider view for model selection. It contains only semantically verified or previously verified records.

policy.include: Suitable for normal factual comparison, subject to task-specific constraints.
policy.include_with_warning: May be compared, but lifecycle/stage caveats must be surfaced.
policy.specialized: Use only when the task explicitly fits the distribution or deployment mode.
policy.exclude: Do not propose by default; retained for legacy/deprecation context.
policy.stale: Do not treat facts as current until revalidated.
